notes.title: CHEATS, TWEAKS & MORE! V1.3 NOW LIVE
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/f3e1c90749e20145c7a72ee9572f77bd1ffd2f76.jpg

Hi everyone,

I hope you've all had a great holiday season!
To celebrate the new year...
An update has floated in from the sea!

This update tweaks the HUD, adds a Cheat Menu and more!

---V1.3.0 PATCH NOTES---

CHEATS MENU:
"Pirates are known to ignore the rules. This book will allow you to activate various cheats!"
A new item has been added to the game which allows you to use some basic cheats.

Access "THE BOOK OF CHEATING" from within your ITEMS and then TREASURE tab. Using cheats will disable saving as well as some achievements.

The cheats currently include:
-USEFUL ITEMS (A collection of extremely useful items which includes RAFTS, SCAVENGER KITS + MORE)

-ALL WEAPONS + ARMOR (Immediately unlocks Weapons & Armor.)

-GOLD BOOST (IMMEDIATELY GRANTS 5000 GOLD)

-MAX LEVEL (INCREASES LEVEL TO 20 & GRANTS 20 PIRATE PERK POINTS)

-MAKE FRIENDS/ENEMIES (ALLOWS YOU TO TURN ALL POSSIBLE FRIENDS/ENEMIES ON/OFF)

HUD TWEAKS:

-The main player HUD which is visible when opening your menu is now available on-screen while exploring. This change will hopefully allow players to better manage things like their
STAMINA, GOLD, RED DAWN PREPAREDNESS, BOUNTIES and DAYS. Additional info is still displayed when opening your menu such as the MAP LOCATION and current SEASON, too.

SPAWN RATE ADJUSTMENTS:
-Various spawn rates of ENEMIES, CRATES, TREASURE and RARE CHESTS have been adjusted in most areas.

COMBAT TWEAKS:
-Some small tweaks have been made which include damage adjustments and weapon range/reach. Combat in Mutiny Island involves using a main handed weapon as well as your secondary pistol which is always equipped. Use the Secondary Attack Button to fire your pistol while attacking with the Main Handed Weapon.

ADDITIONAL DIALOGUE:
Additional dialogue has been added to some of the NPCs. Dialogue can be unlocked by increasing your CHRM stat or by visiting the NPCs on different days/seasons.

Various small bug fixes and optimizations

---END PATCH NOTES---

Thanks, guys!
Happy New Year.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/f3e1c90749e20145c7a72ee9572f77bd1ffd2f76.jpg

Update 1.2.3 is now live for all languages of Mutiny Island! 

---PATCH NOTES---

Player Stat Adjustments:
Most starting stats have received a boost when beginning a new run, In particular, your SIDEARM STAT which is responsible for the damage of your always equipped sidearm.

Additional Areas Which Can Be Decorated:
While playing Mutiny Island you may have stumbled on a few enter-able shipwrecks with their own interiors. These Shipwrecks usually have some high-quality loot as well as a bed for you to rest and save your game. You can now decorate these areas and ALSO select your PIRATE PERKS here too.

Pirate Perks:
You no longer need to purchase a home to register PIRATE PERKS, these can now be registered across various enter-able shipwrecks with a bed, as mentioned above.

Gamepad Prompt:
A new prompt appears when starting the game which recommends players use a controller/gamepad.

Mutiny Island Region Introduction Adjustments:
There have been some additional tutorial prompts and other minor changes made to the first region. A Wooden Axe can also be immediately found once beginning the game.

Additional Tutorial Prompts:
A few extra Tutorial Prompts have been added to certain sequences within the game.

Bug Fix:
Fixed a bug which would prevent DREAMS from playing while sleeping in your purchased home in Tortuga. This bug only affected the one particular bed.

---END PATCH NOTES---

WEEKLY RECAP:

Release of the Official Mutiny Island Soundtrack:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1180160/Mutiny_Island_Soundtrack/

in update V1.2.1 earlier in the week A new EASY DIFFICULTY was added to the base-game where items are not lost on death/drowning. You can select this mode after selecting NEW GAME.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/701224ef48bb8993e70442ba94ee2727b81a7585.jpg

A new free guide has been posted in the Guides Section.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1915513519

New updated trailer + music:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lr2DONQUujE


As always, thank you again for all of the feedback and support.
When releasing Mutiny Island a lot of conscious decisions were made in favor of having a relatively difficult game. I do believe that the general difficulty of the game works but I can see why players could have felt overwhelmed when starting for the very first time. 

I hope the adjustments that have been made since release continue to improve players experiences with the game.

When launching the game, I had hoped to see players communicating among themselves and asking each other questions in regards to what things you could/could not do in the game and how to overcome challenges. 

I really encourage players to ask questions if they feel unsure. You may be surprised at how different some other experiences can be. I'm also available in the official Mutiny Island Discord and will usually get back to questions quickly.

https://discord.gg/uThGjt

The game will continue to receive updates so please send in your requests, suggestions, bug reports and general feedback.

Yaaarrrr!!!!

notes.title: V1.1 out now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

V1.1 is now available for all English Owners and will be released soon for Russian and Simplified Chinese versions.

---MUTINY ISLAND V1.1 PATCH NOTES--

Major Features:
Practice Mode
New first-time tutorial prompts
Keyboard controls always visible in the options menu
Configurable keyboard controls

PRACTICE MODE:
A new playable game mode has been added to the title screen!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/1a4c4311867ad8700d38f70361d1aa091a3198f5.jpg

Practice Mode functions slightly differently from the base game. Items will not be lost upon death or drowning.

Overall, the game can still be completed while playing in Practice Mode but some achievements and Starting Perks are locked.

In Practice Mode, you will begin the game at North Harbor. Once you've loaded, you will be able to choose from three options which will grant you a unique starting bonus.

You can choose from PIRATE, TRADER or a ROYAL.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/cd3f1ef3e83fc376ce47c86fbee2e121736479e9.png

Each choice has its own small unique dialogue and also gives you unique items.
Choosing PIRATE will grant you a weapon and a Pirate Insignia.

Selecting TRADER will give you ONE random building which you can place down outside.

Selecting the ROYAL option will give you 1000 Gold Doubloons and a Trinket Of Charm. The Trinket raises your base CHARM stat and will allow you to unlock loads of dialogue early. This item is/has been located in the base game also. North Harbor is a much "friendlier" place then Mutiny Island and beginning there has loads of benefits. It is a great place to get to grips with the game.

FIRST-TIME TUTORIAL PROMPTS:
When performing certain actions for the first time a new prompt will appear explaining the feature. As an example, entering a Temporary Raft for the first time will now explain that they sink as soon as your feet touch the sand.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/bd413c64dc38efff2e95ef5d0e758f3d386c9130.jpg


KEYBOARD CONTROLS CONFIGURATION:
You can now view and configure the keyboard controls at any time. A new prompt will also appear when starting New Game and/or Practice Mode for the first time which will allow you to adjust options and view/configure controls before playing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/0473318c8c7dddba1204d85918ce456b2ca66d3c.png

Minor Features/Bug Fixes:
Fixed a graphical issue where in some interiors a black line was visible across the roof looking slightly awkward.

Fixed an issue where the Top-Left Menu HUD would fail to display in certain instances, making you unable to view your Gold and Red Dawn Preparedness Bar.

Fixed an issue in North Harbor where the Menu HUD would display the wrong location. It will now say North Harbor as intended.

Fixed a typo where a Pirate Medic would occasionally call you Captain even though you are sailing under someone else's crew.

Text notifications on the side of the screen will stay visible for a slightly longer duration.

Handful of other small bug fixes.

---END PATCH NOTES---

This week has been very busy. Thank you for all the feedback and reviews so far! Please keep them coming and I will do my best to address any issues ASAP.

Just a small recap on the week:

notes.title: Compass Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

An update went live across all three versions earlier which added a new navigational feature to Mutiny Island.

--1.02 PATCHNOTES--

FEATURES:
Introducing the on-screen compass!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/5140d170d0d8d89964f0428a1be0119d35ae5bc6.jpg

The compass points to nearby important NPCs, Temporary Rafts, Treasure, Entrances/Exits and more! You can toggle the compasses size within the options menu. You may have noticed that the compass was present in earlier development footage, but ultimately it was removed for launch with the hope of increasing the difficulty. I see in retrospect it wasn't the best decision and I do apologize to anyone who may have felt overwhelmed when starting the game for the very first time. The compass will be available on new runs. 

BUG FIXES:
When opening up the menu on a Temporary Raft the default choice will no longer hover over the options selection by default.

QOL FIX:
Default sprint times have been slightly increased.

--END PATCH NOTES--

Since launching last week there have been a few updates released which addressed the largest complaints in the game. 

Here's a recap:
Additional small tutorial in the beginning
Navigational on-screen compass
You no longer need to be in the water to place down a raft. 

Mutiny Island on its surface may seem like an ARPG but at its heart, it's got the structure of a basic rouge-lite, survival game. Randomized loot, enemies, and resources mean you will rarely approach two different playthroughs in the same way.

Mutiny Island was designed with the basic idea of being dropped on a deserted island after a Mutiny and doing whatever was necessary to survive and formulate a plan to reclaim your ship based only on the information that you have received on your way. The Red Dawn is constantly moving around the game's world and can appear in your region when you least suspect it which means playthroughs are vastly different for people. If you were expecting more of a traditional RPG experience I do apologize. I did try my best to show as much footage and even gameplay footage before launch as I could. 

Thank you for all the feedback thus far. I will continue updating the game based on what you all recommend. If you run into any bugs or issues please post them in the forums so they can be fixed quickly. Please keep in mind that if there are bugs that they will likely be language/version specific as each language is its own separate build.

EDIT:

A new patch has been released on all three versions which improves the Temporary Raft based on the feedback received. You no longer need to be in the water when placing a Temporary Raft. Facing the water's edge from the shore will allow you to safely place/board your raft with no risk of drowning. Another update will be releasing today with additional improvements.

Hi everyone!

Just a small announcement to let people know that an update will be dropping within 24 hours which should hopefully alleviate some of the concerns that have been expressed in the reviews. The update will release for the English version first.

This update will focus on:
The starting difficulty when spawning on Mutiny Island
Modding Support
Other small additions and fixes

Thank you for the reviews and feedback thus far.
I will avoid responding to steam reviews directly but in saying that, if you do run into any sort of bugs, please consider posting them in the forums first so they can be fixed ASAP.

One of the reviews states that in the Russian version, within 20 minutes there were numerous bugs. To confirm this, I had decided to load a live Broadcast of the Russian version. Ultimately, I could not pinpoint what the reviewer was referencing, so please, try and post your issues in the forums so I can also have a look. If there are translation issues within the Russian and Simplified Chinese version, it would also be appreciated if I could get a heads up. 

This game has essentially been worked on by one person. Translation included. If there are any discrepancies within the translated versions, I do truly apologize and will strive to fix them ASAP. The game should be completely playable with the current translations but I'm happy to improve them if need be.

I just also wanted to add that, in regards to spawning on Mutiny Island, there's MULTIPLE WAYS to leave the area. If you find yourself struggling to make your way of the starting region, usually a RUM TRAFFICKER or a PIRATE will appear within a day or two to offer you some assistance. You can also craft a raft, steal a raft, or even try to island hop.

Thanks, guys!

notes.title: Starter Tips #2
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The Arbor Ocean may seem like an unforgiving place at times...
Mutiny Island was developed with the idea of trial and error as a central mechanic. Deaths and potential restarts may occur while you learn the in's and out's of the world and how you may interact with it.

--SWIMMING--
Take swimming for example. It might not seem like you're able to swim very far at first, but testing/learning the limits will allow you to then use swimming as a tool to "Island Hop" or reach items and treasure floating in the water. Try seeing just how long you can swim before drowning and then use it as an additional tool when exploring. You can even hang onto certain rocks to increase your swimming distance!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/a003223633a7f213caa4978761fc744829deb126.jpg

--TEMPORARY RAFTS--
Temporary Rafts, although not necessary to play the game, definitely make navigating the Arbor a whole lot easier in the beginning. They can either be crafted straight from your inventory or stolen in the waters nearby. Rafts can also be destroyed for loot and EXP. 

When placing a crafted Temporary Raft you will have to be in the water.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/a9acc74336db2583f8a53fb7fea7e2bdbbe58de6.jpg 

Rafts which are found sailing on the water can be boarded by pressing the interact button. You will either steal the Raft immediately or enter into a scuffle with the Raft Owner. Winning the scuffle will pull the sailor out and allow you to steal the boat for yourself. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/98247d92992c985226e40c90081f2fe3c1b7836e.jpg

Press the interact button to hop on once the scuffle has concluded. If you win a scuffle and return to the shore before collecting your Temporary Raft, the Raft will sink. Raft Scuffles are also affected by some of your stats. Try equipping the Captain's Pistol.

--DEATH--
When you first start learning the game, you will most likely die at some point while trying to test out its boundaries. Although you will lose items when respawning, your EXP, Perks, and Equipment remain in-tact. As do your purchases. If you have not made a designated area your home, you will respawn on Mutiny Island. Buying a house in one of the Ports or renting a room at an inn will allow you to change your respawn point. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/89db627809768a18f76205dcbec9661d8e51de7b.jpg

--ITEMS--
If you're concerned about losing items from drowning/death, drop them into a Storage Chest. Storage Chests can be crafted at any time. Your inventory within the chest is universal. That means any crafted storage chest will link into the same inventory cache, making your items accessible from almost anywhere!

--THE RED DAWN--
The Red Dawn is an almost constant threat while playing. You will receive notifications of the Red Dawn's current whereabouts on the side of the screen in the form of a text notification. Be very wary if the Red Dawn enters your current region.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/0d7126589411e5d1d650b368a6d7427306fc02ca.jpg

Good luck!

notes.title: Starter Tips!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
 
Here's some quick tips and general info to get you all started for when
the game launches in a few hours.

--CONTROLS--
Mutiny Island does not use the mouse.
Gamepad is recommended for optimal play and can easily be configured 
within the options menu at any time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/73f61f3610da2e870b4df2c2e4ff1459d987d3ae.jpg

To configure Gamepad controls in-game, go to the options menu while the  controller is plugged in. Select Gamepad Config to change the controls to your liking.

--KEYBOARD CONTROLS--
ARROW KEYS = Movement
Z or SPACEBAR or ENTER = ACCEPT INTERACT OK JUMP
X or ESC or NUM0 = OPEN MENU CANCEL
W or PAGEDOWN = ATTACK
Q or PAGEUP = USE SIDEARM FIRE CANNONBALLS TARGET ENEMY

F3 = ASPECT RATIO
F4 = FULL SCREEN

BASIC GAMEPLAY TIPS:
Tip 1: You don't need to have an Axe actively equipped to chop down trees. (You do need to own one at least.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/6a1827528ed07598b4a7131222411b51e2b7b6fa.jpg

Tip 2: (RAFT CHANGED TIP NOT VALID) You must be in the water when trying to place a crafted Temporary Raft. Managing your swimming is an important mechanic in Mutiny Island. You can only swim in the water for a limited amount of time. Pay attention to the sound and visual text indicator on the side of the screen as it will indicate how close to drowning you are. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/a9acc74336db2583f8a53fb7fea7e2bdbbe58de6.jpg

Tip 3: Attacking consumes stamina as does swimming.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/4d99cd3b8f3b5a69c1c03f28a42c0c4ee959bc22.jpg

Tip 4: Don't be scared to restart if you feel like it. Although Mutiny Island is not a rogue-like, it does share some similarities. After watching the introduction cut-scene the first time, you can skip it in subsequent reruns.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/981046e11f249105900f37db5b2dc3a87f8e082c.png

Tip 5: If you see a Naval Vessel on fire in the ocean, there's a chance you can scavenge it for treasure! Be mindful to manage your swimming and not drown.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/58a816d18145c646140cf60c1f1e9caad37bab12.jpg

Tip 6: Beds can be used as a respawn point, as long as
they are not owned. Beds are also used to save the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/1ec19c5f424092d61ff7e00441f5ac0d7486dfc0.jpg

Tip 7: Lots of things in the environment can be interacted with.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/621e44e7adff111f7a7dfa4abb3768ea8fa06b3d.png

Tip 8: Ports are the best place to sell your treasure, weapons and supplies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/1ff765af38a633815692a3dc3cde9743d1ea1f07.jpg

Tip 9: Store items you don't want to risk losing in a Storage Chest.
Personal Storage Chest Cache can be accessed anywhere from the
map, as long as you have a Chest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/a04e9c0e57d451dff475e38d27dae248194db9e8.jpg

Tip 10: Drowning or Dying will make you lose some of your held items.
Equipment you're actively wearing is unaffected. The more you play, the more accustomed you will become to your swimming cues, which will allow you to travel more freely. Practice your swimming to get a good idea of your limits. You might even find an unexpected island or treasure! The more you swim, the better your swimming capabilities will become.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/a003223633a7f213caa4978761fc744829deb126.jpg

--CHANGE LANGUAGE--
Right click the game within the Steam Client and then open up "Properties". Select the Languages tab at the top and select which language you would like.

Good luck out there me hearties!

notes.title: Mutiny Island will set sail Oct 18, 2019 @ 8:00pm PDT
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I'm happy to announce the Mutiny Island will be launching this week on the 18th of Oct at 18:00 PDT time! English, Simplified Chinese and Russian will be available on release.

If you haven't been keeping up to date with all the latest gameplay info, here are some handy links to catch you up.

A bunch of screenshots and videos have been posted over the last month on the official Facebook page as well as new information on some of the gameplay mechanics that will be available in the game.

Screenshots & Info
https://www.facebook.com/MutinyIsland

There's also a shorter gameplay FAQ which can be found on the Mutiny Island Steam store page.

Gameplay FAQ
https://steamcommunity.com/games/709490/announcements/detail/1586880891228057894

If you're interested in getting an idea of how the game plays and not too fussed on some light-spoilers, there's an 8-minute gameplay video which can be found below.

8 Min Introduction Gameplay Video
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=My1IYrrd2ns

Really can't wait for you all to finally play!
 
Mutiny Island was a joy to work on. The setting, the music, everything.
It's taken a lot of work to get this game together, especially under some of the circumstances while developing, but I'm glad that it's finally going to be released. It was also amazing to finally have a chance and compose the entire soundtrack for a game. I truly hope you all enjoy it. 

Thanks, guys.
YARRR!!!

notes.title: Gameplay FAQ
notes.content:
--DEATH--
Passing out from lack of stamina, enemy damage or drowning will result in you respawning back on Mutiny Island or a bed that you've made your designated home. You will also lose some basic items and equipment upon death or drowning. Weapons and armor that you have actively equipped will not be lost.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/a04e9c0e57d451dff475e38d27dae248194db9e8.jpg

--STATS--
Stats such as CHARM and LUCK will affect your interactions with NPC's and Shopkeepers. Increasing the various stats in the game can result in you being able to negotiate better sale prices or assist in seducing women.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/f94011e6a82b03c70b527316dc1b90758937b9f8.jpg

--STEALING RAFTS--
If you don't feel like crafting a Temporary Raft, you can steal one that's making its way through the ocean. The raft owner might put up a fight though.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/14c3743cd67a7058e880695780bcc3a8039efc07.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/98247d92992c985226e40c90081f2fe3c1b7836e.jpg

--TASK BOARDS--
There are many ways to earn Gold Doubloons while playing Mutiny Island. If you stumble upon a Task Board, make sure to check it out for any available tasks. Task Boards can be found within Ports and also onboard Ships that you own or are part of a crew.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/4abd046cc58d473d508967a5a76547178cae11c4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/07cea2937481e8963f39ae8f16ada18c182a5cea.png

--DEFENDING YOUR SHIP--
Your ship can and will occasionally be boarded while sailing the sea. Make sure to investigate the enemy vessel for any loot and treasure. If you take too long, your ship can sink from all of the incoming cannon fire!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/cdb0b83d774ad555962918d76799408e07ab186f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/1e4d441c2bf5187b962e28a86389f80d61d21cfd.jpg

--NORTH HARBOR--
North Harbor used to be your home. Now it's been destroyed.
If you know how to craft buildings you can rebuild the town in your image. The more buildings you construct, the more people who might want to move into your town.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/501677a00b514d00fc5ca4dc329c10fafa03d9b4.jpg

--ARMADA--
Tired of fighting your own battles?
Once you've bought your Royal Galleon or Pirate Frigate, speak to the Harbor Master behind the counter to recruit an Armada.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/96116dd546d4f01af08ed4625c001a060894a258.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/94ea12998fdc8a7daff85bbd6a1e1a77e6c7bca3.jpg

--DAY & NIGHT--
A Day and Night Cycle dictates how the world changes around you.
Different wildlife, monsters and NPC's will appear based on the region, time and day.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/2b211e9c4c386b117a13d7e8d4582c5b5355683a.jpg

--SWIMMING--
The whole game world is open right from the beginning.
You can swim anywhere there's water but you will risk the possibility of drowning and losing items doing so. Swimming often will increase your Swimming Skill and duration that you can stay afloat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/52525bad1897ceab388613892563ee0a7d5750bc.jpg

--RED DAWN PREPAREDNESS--
There is a "Red Dawn Preparedness" meter which tracks how capable you are of challenging the Red Dawn at any given moment. This bar will increase or decrease based on your level, currently equipped equipment and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/f311e047da3b7bd9fe8330f81484f2020c26fbd5.jpg

--TREASURE--
If you want to make some quick Gold Doubloons, head to the local ports and sell some stock!
Each merchant is different and will only take certain kinds of items.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/1ff765af38a633815692a3dc3cde9743d1ea1f07.jpg

--MULTI-LANGUAGE SUPPORT-
Mutiny Island will be playable in multiple languages on release.
The languages available are English, Russian, Simplified. Additional languages will arrive shortly after launch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/5c4a397145be0b16b1df26dc5abac094fa2111c3.jpg

--STRANDED--
If you find yourself trapped on some faraway island, try and break down a few trees to craft yourself a Temporary Raft!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/6a1827528ed07598b4a7131222411b51e2b7b6fa.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/b194d09daf03c4d9c7bd905c0c7f393fabe2f10b.jpg

--RESOLUTION--
Mutiny Island can be played in a variety of resolutions. Change the resolution in game at anytime using the Options menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/0c32676ec08bbf3db33ff09542b3f86cdeba9dc4.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/ff0b2aa4151051dafada3954809fd065fe79d517.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35239539/09b2332d587cc09ba8d4d5e8025f8ee1bbbdc396.png
